actions.name: Pyro Dragons
actions.description:
Effect: This attack summons the Dragon Veins. They pursue a specified target, lasting for 3 activations with an AV of 90.

These attacks utilise the user's ATK stat, at power 85, gain +2 Effectiveness Stages vs @Trait[dragon] creatures, and have the @Trait[earthbound] trait.

The Dragon Veins' attacks inflict @UUID[Compendium.ptr2e-digimon-expansion.core-effects.Item.I1z28u5ma3IItySu]{Vulnerable (Fire)} for 3 activations each time they successfully hit.
